thread:
alex.k: FYI escalation from ACME Prod — customer reports SSE stream dropped mid-response during LTE -> WiFi bounce. They got a partial JSON chunk then the connection closed. They say client didn't reconnect automatically. Request-id: r-0a1b2c3d.

ben.support: Got their browser/server logs. attaching snippet they sent:
```
client: curl --header \"Accept: text/event-stream\" \"https://api.redwood.ai/v1/stream?model=gpt-x\" \n...connected..recv partial payload..
recv: 200 OK
data: {\"choices\": [\"partial text...\"]}
socket: FIN, then ECONNRESET
```

sam.eng: Thanks. Quick q — do we see proxy 502/504 or upstream RST? Can you paste r-0a1b2c3d from our edge logs?

alex.k: Edge logs attached from customer time (~2026-02-12T15:03:22Z) show: `edge-conn: established, client_ip=10.2.3.4 -> proxy -> upstream; 15s later: tcp packet from client during NAT rebinding; proxy logs: \"connection closed by client\"`

maria.sre: I pulled our load-balancer trace for r-0a1b2c3d: upstream received a TCP FIN from client after the IP changed (carrier->wifi). NAT conntrack expired; kernel sent RST to upstream. This matches midstream half-close pattern.

jessica.qa: I reproduced locally: iPhone tether + toggle wifi off/on quickly while streaming SSE. Steps:
1) Start SSE from laptop through phone hotspot
2) Trigger long response (~45s) from model
3) Toggle WiFi off/on on phone during stream
Result: client sees partial data then socket close, no auto-reconnect.

sam.eng: Repro confirmed. Two quick mitigations: 1) recommend client-side keepalive/shorter reconnect policy and resume-token support; 2) server-side: reduce idle timeouts and enable TCP keepalive on proxy -> upstream to avoid conntrack expiry.

ben.support: Customer is pushing for immediate workaround and asks about billing for partial response. I told them we're investigating and we'd offer a credit if we caused it. Logging ticket to billing.

maria.sre: Action items:
- Add ephemeral metric to track half-close events by reason code (tcp_fin, nat_rebind, client_rst) — short-term alert.
- Adjust proxy config: enable SO_KEEPALIVE, keepalive_time=20s (was 2m), keepalive_intvl=5s.
- Review edge conntrack TTLs in our cloud NAT path.

sam.eng: Also scanning code path for resume: server should accept a resume token in header `X-Resume-Request: r-0a1b2c3d` and rehydrate KV cache for same model+prompt. If resume not possible then return 409 with partial boolean so client knows.

jessica.qa: I can test config change in staging if infra pushes small proxy flag. Repro deck ready.

deploy-bot: deploy/edge-proxy-keepalive-flag to staging started by maria.sre at 5523456798 — build b-772 -> staged. :rocket:

alex.k: Thanks team — customer update in 1h. Ben, update them with the repro steps and planned staging test. Jess, ping me when staging passes and we'll schedule a controlled rollout.

ben.support: Will do. Offering temporary credit hold until root cause confirmed. :+1:

maria.sre: Note: long-term fix might be promoting resume tokens and client SDK guidance for mobile handoffs. I'll open a spec PR.

sam.eng: FYI we should also add an internal KB: "SSE midstream NAT rebind — triage checklist". I'll draft it.

alex.k: Closing loop: log ticket created (SUP-9872), billing notified, staging test in progress.
